answer: Tags are checked against the file's public key each epoch, and a failed tag voids the claim. A homomorphic tag lets the verifier check a block without downloading it, so possession is proven cheaply. A farm needs 175 separate possession proofs, since one tag cannot prove 175 files are held. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the inlet signal is public, the raven check is automatic, and 175 aliases cost 175 times what one real agent costs, with the umber trail open to all.
